notes.title: A thank you from us to you
notes.content:
Hello detectives, 

Its been a touch over two weeks since the release of Sherlock Holmes The Awakened. We waited with bated breath to see your reactions - and we were positively taken back by them. We have read the reviews, the tweets, and comments across the online verse and in our inboxes. We saw countless gameplay streams, screenshots, and all the excitement as you experience a story that is dear to our hearts. We cheer when you solve a complex puzzle, or when you comment that a particular level, character, or line of dialogue is your favourite. Seeing how well received The Awakened is made us proud that we were able to deliver a game that you all enjoyed playing. We can’t thank you enough for the support and love shown.

To say the development of this has been hell due to circumstances beyond our control, would be an understatement. At the start of 2022, we had planned to create a totally different game, one that would require everyone in the office to collaborate - as we always do. The war came and tore apart that dream. As being artists and world-creators is our way of life, we used our creativity to readjust to keep ourselves continuing while living through the horror. In the midst of blackouts, sirens blaring, and explosions nearby, we found solace inside the story of Sherlock Holmes The Awakened. A story of one man bent on bringing otherworldly horror to the rest of the world (and who says that art doesn’t imitate life?). Creating this game for you, our fans, kept us going through tough times. 

Now that Sherlock Holmes The Awakened is in your hands, we couldn’t be more proud of seeing how everyone is experiencing it in their own way. You gave us the kick to chase our next dream game project, and so that is where we are heading towards. More on that at the right time.	

Thank you again for all your support, and for playing Sherlock Holmes The Awakened.


From Ukraine with love, 

Your Team Frogwares

notes.title: Sherlock Holmes The Awakened is now available to play!
notes.content:
Detectives, we have arrived! 

After much anticipation, Sherlock Holmes The Awakened has been released! Enjoy the Lovecraftian madness.

[previewyoutube=9ehpDZCFtr8;full][/previewyoutube]

We made this game during one heck of a time. We made it while our country is at war. We faced challenges such as constant power outages, irregular work schedules, air raids, evacuations, losing our homes, saying goodbyes to our loved ones (through immigration, or worse), and losing team members so that they could defend our country. We woked from our homes, our office, and from underground bunkers or train stations. It was an enduring and unending nightmare. But with all this chaos around, working on The Awakened helped us maintain a little sense of normalcy. We truly gave it all - sweat, emotions, and spirit to the development of this game.

We express our sincere gratitude to our families and friends for their unwavering support. It’s in times like these that you feel how important people that you can rely on really are. We send our heartfelt thanks to our Kickstarter supporters for their patience and encouragement through this time too. You backing us meant the world as it gave us confidence that there are thousands of people out there wanting to experience The Awakened all over again. And to all of our supporters, please know that your kindness deeply touched us over the last year. The amount of heart and positivity was overwhelming. Some of you even wrote to us and offered a place in their homes. How beautifully… beautiful is that. So thank you once again for all of your support.

Lastly, we would be thrilled to hear your thoughts on the game! Please feel free to tag us or send us a message to share your feedback. We would love to hear your opinions.

Ok, that’s it from us. Enjoy solving the case, detective.


Speak soon,
Your Frogwares Team

notes.title: A few words on the Sherlock Holmes The Awakened Release Date
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

While the development of the game since April 2022 had always been challenging due to the war, the last 5 months starting in October 2022 have been extremely difficult for our team. 

As you may know, initially we were aiming to release our game in a February / early March release window. Unfortunately, the relentless strikes on civilian infrastructure in Ukraine have forced us to work around continual blackouts and redo the entire production pipeline. Due to the effects of the ongoing war in Ukraine, we need a few more weeks to finish Sherlock Holmes The Awakened. We are forced to move the release date for the game to late March / April 2023.

We've created a video showing how we are getting ready for the release, our current situation in Kyiv, as well as new gameplay footage captured on PC, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch.

[previewyoutube=d5XiUNnjp-4;full][/previewyoutube]
We’ve been trying really hard to make our planned release window, but the near-daily interruptions of electricity, on top of the missile attacks that come every 10 days or so, meant we had to replan everything. It also means the game itself has been impacted too, not just the schedule. But we’ll do our best and push on as much as we can. Once we feel we are maybe a month away from release, we’ll be able to announce our exact release date.

Thank you very much for your understanding and support! We’ll talk soon!

Love,
Frogwares

notes.title: The backstory of Sherlock and Watson in Sherlock Holmes The Awakened
notes.content:
Whenever we think of Sherlock or Watson, we never think of them as separate individuals so much, do we? They are one of the most iconic duos of pop culture. So if you are a big fan of the two, you’re probably wondering how they fit within the world we created. Well, let us explain.

Sherlock Holmes The Awakened is set in London in the latter months of 1882. It follows on from the events that took place in Sherlock Holmes Chapter One. For the last year, Sherlock and John have been roommates at the not-yet-iconic 221B Baker Street apartment in London. They are just roommates for now. Each has his own life and problems but they live together because they have no other choice. Sherlock is doing some odd and small detective cases around the neighbourhood, while John is trying to restart his medical career after coming back from the war in Afghanistan. Sherlock is still his arrogant self, missing his best friend Jon from Cordona. However, he is taking a shine to Watson - he enjoys his company. John on the other hand is tinkering with his hobby, writing novels, and he uses Sherlock’s cases as an inspiration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753650/4412d88ab9fc67e3e3e122875d590d85530b8e30.png[/img]

They are two young men doing their own thing and sharing a living space - pretty far from the iconic duo that we know. You might say that they are still trying to figure out who they are. Until one September day a trivial case, the vanishing of a Maori servant, would take them on an adventure to four countries, two continents, and places in their minds that they didn’t know existed. You might say that Sherlock Holmes The Awakened tells the story of how perhaps the greatest crime-fighting duo of all time started. It’s the origin story of Sherlock Holmes and John Watson.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753650/04ea858c94cbef6d4cb53a4715ebcb7feb0cea25.png[/img]

There are other emotions and arcs that will be intertwined within the story, ones that also trace back to our previous game Sherlock Holmes Chapter One. But we thought that it might be good to leave those out, at least for now. Some mysteries need to be uncovered at the right time.


Until next time, 

Your Frogwares team

notes.title: Fear of the unknown and psychological horror in The Awakened
notes.content:
The Awakened takes place just a few years after the events of our 2021 release, Sherlock Holmes Chapter One. Holmes and Watson are not yet the inseparable investigative duo but rather just roommates, renting a flat at 221B Baker Street. Together they undertake to investigate what seems like a simple missing person’s case but soon unravels to being something more sinister and beyond comprehension.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753650/93db4a38516f04f74240942dcac7c7d405d13104.png[/img]

The most fascinating thing about The Awakened, is how it unites two seemingly opposite concepts: the rationality of Conan Doyle’s novels and Lovecraft’s “incomprehensible” approach to horror. Sherlock is up against an entity so unfathomable that it makes him truly afraid and question everything he knows and stands for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753650/e21fc8f3387073a4fba778f16140c863bfd9ed14.png[/img]

This is our creative take on what series of truly horror-filled events could have met our heroes at this point in their lives and go on to shape them into the people we all know they are to become. The trauma and fear that cements their friendship for good. The revelations that break Sherlock’s mind to create the flawed and haunted genius he is destined to be. And the outcomes of a case that make both forever question the reality of the world and the purpose of existing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753650/5554784ee4c4ad90b30641ef687bd47c2f7c7a6e.jpg[/img]

This is a maddening discovery, one that Dr Watson will never publish for the sake of mankind and for the sake of his friend.


Once again, thank you all for your overwhelming support! You all funded the project in about 6 hours, and we are absolutely thrilled to have you by our side. We are now getting close to unlocking our 4th (!!) Stretch Goal! This is the best sort of insanity we could ever ask for. 


Once again, thanks for your support. 
We’ll speak to each other real soon.



All the best, 

Your Frogwares Team

notes.title: Meet your future best friend, Dr. John Watson
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are now 18 days into our Kickstarter campaign and we are still blown away by all the support we are receiving! It’s humbling and uplifting at the same time. And seeing the number of backers who pledged our game is also insane - in a good way of course (not the Cthulhu kind of insane). We thought that today might be a good day to tell you more about Dr. John Watson, Sherlock’s “other half” so to speak. After all, you will be spending quite a lot of time together in The Awakened, so you might as well get to know him just a little bit more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753650/99cb54f5b6d40b7771b0f8072be61bfb52749a17.jpg[/img]

Sherlock Holmes The Awakened begins at a time when both Sherlock and Watson are already living together in London at 221B Baker Street. They aren’t close friends; more like roommates that are living together out of necessity. Sherlock isn’t the famous detective that we all know him for. Those big and famous cases aren’t coming in just yet. Right now it’s more like small, petty investigations from people around the neighbourhood. Watson is a war veteran, who recently returned from Afghanistan. To make ends meet, he decided to open a medical practice. The business isn’t exactly “booming” - he only has a handful of patients and he occasionally works as a substitute for other more famous doctors in London. 

His work is just that - work. However, he does have a passion that’s keeping his inner-flame alight. That passion? Writing. While in Afghanistan, Watson kept a diary to help him cope with all the negative emotions that war threw at him. Since coming back from Afghanistan, this journal helps him deal with the stresses and nightmares that he still sees in his mind ever since the war ended. And this writing bug really dug deep into him. He now wants to share his writings with the world. Sherlock’s little investigations become his inspirations. Watson is someone that believes that magic and the supernatural exist, as sometimes there are things that logic cannot explain. Perhaps he is the best companion that Sherlock could ask for, as there will be events in The Awakened that will test even the most skeptical mind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753650/ac24e4c0ab50ce5c5970bf604d74e0f20ef0b7cd.png[/img]

We hope you like the sound of our Watson. There is a lot more to him, but we thought of leaving some mystery around him so there’s more for you to discover later on. Once again, thank you from the bottom of our collective heart for all the support! We’ll be giving you more details on Sherlock Holmes The Awakened as our Kickstarter campaign evolves, so stay vigilant! We’ll be talking to you real soon.


All the best, 

Your Frogwares Team


PS. Support us on Kickstarter right here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/frogwares/sherlock-holmes-the-awakened

notes.title: Experience Sherlock’s descent into madness with our insanity puzzles
notes.content:
The Awakened, being a Lovecraftian game, features certain psychological themes such as fear of the unknown and mental decay. Sherlock is up against an entity beyond human comprehension, which causes him to slowly descend into madness as he gets closer to the grand reveal.

In the game, we want to convey that feeling through both story and gameplay. Our team designed what we call insanity puzzles that seek to implement four core concepts:

[list]
[*] A dreadful atmosphere of madness, loneliness and hopelessness
[*] Otherworldly environments
[*] Counter-intuitive and illogical solutions that require thinking outside the box
[*] Feeling of satisfaction and relief when each puzzle is solved
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753650/7b7f485983d39d03ca9ad4e27df6684d4fd92d34.png[/img]

Each puzzle will present a clear goal (i.e open the metaphoric door to get out), but the rest is up to you to figure out.

The puzzles will be getting progressively more difficult and madness-inducing as the story goes on. Furthermore, Sherlock’s appearance will also gradually change to portray his mental state which keeps getting worse. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753650/86f0cc8bb7d5a69b664ff6dee21659587b1d05f3.png[/img]

Thank you to all of you that have supported us throughout our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/frogwares/sherlock-holmes-the-awakened/description]Kickstarter campaign![/url] We are blown away by your comments, feedback and support. If you are considering backing us, please do so now. You’ll be able to get the game at a better price and you can score some exclusive perks and rewards too. 


Once again, thanks for your support. We’ll speak to each other real soon.


All the best, 

Your Frogwares Team

notes.title: Meet our hero, the not-yet world-famous Sherlock Holmes
notes.content:
Our Kickstarter campaign is now in full swing - and blowing away all of our expectations. Thank you (yes you!), for all of your support, kind words, and pledges. When we started our Kickstarter campaign, we had a bit of an idea of what we can expect. But we certainly didn’t expect this. This is wild. So thank you for playing a part in bringing our game to life. Today we wanted to give you a bit of info on our main character, Sherlock Holmes. After all, since we’ll be stepping into his shoes, we might as well get to know him a little better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753650/68ee0bc5a3a89b7d10cee6d3d13c534df683cbc7.jpg[/img]
[i]Sherlock Holmes[/i]

The story of The Awakened takes place a few years after the events in Sherlock Holmes Chapter One. Our Sherlock is still unknown, far away from the fame that he will have in his later years. Living in London together with his relatively new roommate, and somewhat of a friend John Watson (although the concept of “friendship” is still a bit foreign to him), Sherlock is starting to dip his toes into being a detective. He is known around the neighbourhood as the “go-to” man if you’re missing something, but it is still all local fame. He hasn’t got a big, juicy case yet.. But this is all about to change…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753650/5fc1a6f0cda64746f23939c07c41c51b5c3a607c.png[/img]
[i]Sherlock Holmes outfits concept[/i]

The Sherlock from The Awakened is a young 25-year-old confident man who has an undeniable air of genius around him. No matter where he walks in, he is the smartest person in that room. If unoccupied, his mind rushes with thoughts that sometimes open old wounds. To stop that from happening, Sherlock keeps it busy. He hates boredom. Our Sherlock is a free spirit that doesn’t shy away from eccentricity or theatrics. And most importantly, he believes that everything can be rationally explained. The most mysterious thing only seems mysterious because we know little about it. But everything becomes evident when you take a closer look. Everything can be explained. He trusts his mind’s judgement. But when his mind played tricks on him in the past, a bit of paranoia crept in ever since.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753650/99cb54f5b6d40b7771b0f8072be61bfb52749a17.jpg[/img]
[i]Sherlock and John[/i]

As with each story that we make, we want our characters to grow by the time the credits roll. The Sherlock that you will meet in the beginning will be a different man by the time the case is solved. What will his transition be like? Well, that is for you to experience yourself.

Thanks for spending that little bit of time with us. We hope that you like the sound of our Sherlock. And once again, thank you for all your support so far. There is still time before the campaign ends, so if you would like to make a pledge or if you would like to upgrade the pledge you’ve already made, you can do so right now. We will be back real soon with more info about Sherlock Holmes The Awakened, so stay tuned to your inbox! And as always, if you have any questions, just ask away.
